text:
maya: Quick intake for vector-11b quant candidate on dev-staging. Short checklist attached — basic correctness, tokenizer edge cases, small prompt suite. Ping @devon @kevin for infra / reservations.

devon: Ack. Will reserve a slot on dev-stg-gpu-pool-2 for ~30m. Which quant recipe are we testing?

maya: int8-static using qconfig v2 (rowwise + symmetric fallback). Model tag: vector-11b-q8a. Prompt set below.

liam: I'll run the smoke harness and post a short summary (pass/fail + mismatch counts). Do we have a baseline run id?

maya: baseline = vector-11b-fp16 (prod-x). Baseline run id: run_2149990001. Thresholds: <=3% drop in top-1 correctness, <=1% increase in hallucination flag.

maya: Prompt set (very small):

```
1) "What is 15 + 27?"
2) "Summarize: The API returns 200 on success. How would you explain to a new dev?"
3) Instruction: "Write a short Python function to reverse a string."
4) JSON output test: "Return a JSON object with keys name, age, languages"
5) Long-context prefix test: repeat 'token' 600 times then ask 'How many tokens did I repeat?'
```

audrey: Add tokenizer edge cases: leading/trailing whitespace, mixed unicode, and \"smart quotes\".

infra-bot: Reservation created: dev-stg-slot-42 (gpu-pool-2) until 2151234860.

liam: Kicking off now. Setting REDWOOD_TRACE=1, enabling KV cache stats. ETA ~8m.

devon: Noted — set max_seq to 2048 for that slot in case of long-context tests.

liam: Partial results: arithmetic ok. Instruction-following sometimes truncates at 512 tokens for the long-context prompt. Paste of example output:

```
Input: (600x 'token' prefix) + "How many tokens did I repeat?"
Output: "...token token token" <truncated>
Truncation point: 512 tokens (expected 600)
```

maya: Likely seq_len config mismatch on the inference container. @devon can you bump max_seq to 2048 on that slot?

devon: Done — max_seq set to 2048 and rolling restart initiated. :thumbsup:

liam: Rerun complete. All sanity checks green except JSON output formatting for prompt #4 — an extra trailing comma in one sample. Filing a quick ticket INC-642 to track formatting regression.

audrey: I'll inspect the eval harness normalizer — probably needs to strip trailing commas and normalize whitespace before comparison. Adding the failing prompt to the regression set.

kevin: If everything else is ok, we should mark this as dev-stg:smoke-pass and schedule dedicated bring-up.

maya: Agreed. Marking vector-11b-q8a as smoke-pass on dev-stg. Results uploaded to S3: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/devstg/runs/vector-11b-q8a/2151234567/results.json

audrey: I'll follow up with a short PR to the harness to fix JSON normalization and add tokenizer edge-case tests.

maya: Great work team — thanks. Next steps: if the regression PR lands and CI passes, promote to dedicated candidate pool for throughput quals. :white_check_mark:
